workerResult.summary: Brine Clock — a biomorphic tide timer that breathes with the sea. A live canvas 'Tidal Pool' dial driven by a synthetic lunar tide model (M2+S2+K1) with an organic breathing blob-ring, wave surface, rising foam bubbles, a coral fin-hand, flood/ebb chevrons, and next high/low countdowns. A jelly breath-sync orb paces tidal breathing (4-12 breaths/min slider) and counts breaths. A CSS-drawn harbor bell rings the traditional ship's-bell watch schedule (1-8 bells incl. split dog watches) with Web Audio synthesized bell tones (no audio files), a manual ring, and a persisted sound toggle. Custom biomorphic identity: Fraunces/Figtree typography, deep-abyss ocean palette, drifting blurred blobs, CSS grain, asymmetric grid. No images anywhere — CSS + canvas only. Preferences persist in localStorage. Built with Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind v4, relative base paths; build passes and preview serves correctly.
